title: R1 W1 only partially folded: the audio_flush duck call-site ordering remains unpinned, and the test comment overclaims it
detail: audio_flush is device-gated and never runs in any test, so moving flush_maybe_duck(a) after a.pending = {} fails nothing — the comment's ordering claim is false. The predicate/family-list half is genuinely pinned; the ordering half of W1 is not.
recommended_fix: Extract the ordered check-then-clear into one pure proc both audio_flush and the test drive, or correct the comment to claim only the predicate/trigger pin and record the ordering as structurally guarded.

title: Pause soft-lower acceptance wiring unobserved: the unmuted bed_update path never executes in any test
evidence:
au.bed_update(&app.audio, f32(min(f64(rl.GetFrameTime()), 0.25)), app.mode == .Paused)  — the only test-side call (app/audio/audio_test.odin:391-394) runs muted: "	toggle_mute(&a)
	a.bed_duck_t = MUSIC_DUCK_SECS // stale state that must survive untouched
	bed_update(&a, 0.1, false)
	testing.expectf(t, a.bed_duck_t == MUSIC_DUCK_SECS, \"muted bed_update advanced the envelope\")" — i.e. it exercises only the muted early-return.
detail: The 'Pause (5.3) soft-lowers the bed' acceptance behavior hinges on one unpinned wiring line; inverting it (app.mode != .Paused) ships with all gates green. The pure level math is pinned; the frame-loop application path is not.
recommended_fix: Pin the mode-to-paused mapping in a pure helper tested headless, or an app-level wiring assertion; at minimum mark the call site manual-verified like the flush-half discipline.

title: Committed OGG asset has no automated integrity/decode check — the headline feature can be silently absent with all gates green
evidence: - **No CI-gate change for the OGG:** a broken asset surfaces at runtime with a clear stderr note; the pinned input/output sha256s let any reviewer cross-check the binary (a decode gate would require touching the GH workflow + its local replica — deferred).  — assets/audio/README.md:109: "(verify with `shasum -a 256 assets/audio/ambience_loop.ogg`)". Grep of tools/ci-local.sh and tools/harness.sh for ambience/.ogg/ffprobe/shasum/sha256 returns nothing.
detail: If the asset is omitted, truncated, or undecodable, load_bed's silent fallback means no music while every T1/T2/replay/unit gate passes. The deferral is documented and deliberate; the residual NONE-coverage stands.
recommended_fix: Add one cheap CI line: shasum the committed OGG against the README pin (ae134e17…405d10) or ffprobe its duration — no GH workflow redesign needed for a local-replica gate.

title: R2-fold logic inside the device-gated init/destroy halves (boot fade-in seed, decode-fail unload, stop-before-unload) has zero automated coverage
detail: The r2 folds added new behavior inside procs no test reaches: boot fade-in envelope seeding, the W6 decode-fail UnloadMusicStream, and the note-5 stop-before-unload ordering. Consistent with the pre-existing flush-half discipline, but regression-invisible.
recommended_fix: Extract the boot envelope seeding into a pure helper asserted beside the envelope tests; document init/destroy bed halves as manual-only, mirroring the spec's flush-integration note.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: golden suite green, zero consumer draws verified (harness untouched), duck/mute pure cores pinned by 8 new tests. P1 ≈85%: flush-ordering pin overclaimed, pause wiring + boot/asset halves manual-only (documented deferrals). Overall ≈85% of the delta's testable surface traced.
recommended_fix: Genuinely pin the audio_flush duck call-site ordering (shared pure proc both sides call) and add the CI asset-integrity line; together they lift P1 past 90% to PASS.
